# Field Reference

<!-- Generated by `python3 scripts/wiki_tool.py sync-schema` from Schema/wiki-config.json (or the built-in defaults). Do not edit by hand. -->

Profile: `togaf-core`. Narrative rules and examples: `Schema/frontmatter-schema.md`.

## Source notes (`Raw/Sources/`)

| Field | Type | Required | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Title` | string | yes |  | The source's own title |
| `Author` | string | recommended |  | As written in the source; never guessed |
| `Reference` | string | yes |  | URL, DOI or bibliographic reference |
| `ContentType` | list of strings | recommended |  | What the source contains: markdown, pdf, image, … |
| `Created` | date | yes |  | Date the source was added to the vault |
| `Processed` | bool | yes |  | true once compiled into Wiki/ |
| `tags` | list of strings | yes |  | Must include source |

## Compiled notes (`Wiki/`)

Core fields, required on every kind:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tags` | list | Exactly one tag: the note's kind, matching its folder (F3) |
| `topics` | list of links → topics kind | Notes of the topics kind this note belongs under (F8); may be [] |
| `status` | string | One of the configured statuses (F6) |
| `created` | date | Date the note was created (F5) |
| `updated` | date | Date of the last change; on or after created (F5) |
| `sources` | list of links → source | Raw sources this note cites (S1, S2, S4) |
| `source_count` | int | Equals the number of sources (F4) |
| `aliases` | list of strings | Other names; used by search and duplicate detection (N4) |

Allowed `status` values: `seed`, `growing`, `stable`, `stale`.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TM1` | `anchor_required` | error | `domain`, `actor`, `assumption`, `business-capability`, `business-service`, `capability`, `constraint`, `course-of-action`, `data-entity`, `function`, `gap`, `location`, `logical-application-component`, `logical-technology-component`, `organization-unit`, `physical-application-component`, `physical-technology-component`, `principle`, `process`, `requirement`, `role`, `technology-service`, `value-stream`, `work-package` | Every citation points at an exact heading or block, never the whole source — required so a human reviewer can check classification_basis against the source. |
